targets.rawSql:
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s';
SET LOCAL work_mem = '64MB';
SET LOCAL jit = off;
/* REALTIME DRILLING FLEET OPERATIONS - DYNAMIC TIME-WINDOW & INDUSTRIAL WATCHDOG */
WITH RECURSIVE all_eqp AS (
   (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id > t.equipment_id AND equipment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1)
   FROM all_eqp t
   WHERE t.equipment_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest_per_eqp AS (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, mm.factory, me.*
  FROM all_eqp e
  LEFT JOIN public.machine_master mm ON mm.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      event_type, event_code, event_message, event_time, spindle, id
    FROM public.machine_event m
    WHERE m.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
      AND $__timeFilter(m.event_time)
    ORDER BY m.event_time DESC, m.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) me
  WHERE e.equipment_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ('All' IN (${factory:sqlstring}) OR mm.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}))
),
fleet_ref AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN NOW() - MAX(event_time) > INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN MAX(event_time)
      ELSE to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0)
    END AS anchor_time
  FROM latest_per_eqp
),
window_tool_events AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS tool_event_count
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND event_code = ANY(ARRAY['0110', '0214', '0215', '0308', '0310', '0211', '0115', '0119', '0417', '0114', '0120'])
    AND ('All' IN (${factory:sqlstring})
         OR equipment_id IN (SELECT mm.equipment_id FROM public.machine_master mm WHERE mm.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})))
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    l.equipment_id,
    l.factory,
    l.event_type,
    l.event_code,
    l.event_message,
    l.event_time,
    l.spindle,
    l.id,
    p.prog,
    rf.rpm,
    rf.feed,
    h.holes,
    sp.sp_report,
    sp.s1, sp.s2, sp.s3, sp.s4, sp.s5, sp.s6,
    COALESCE(sa.alm_mask, (regexp_match(l.event_message, '(?i)spin[a-z]*[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)'))[1]::int) AS alm_mask,
    COALESCE(sa.event_message, l.event_message) AS alm_msg,
    CASE 
      WHEN fr.anchor_time - l.event_time >= INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN 'COMM LOSS'
      WHEN fr.anchor_time - l.event_time >= INTERVAL '1 hour' 
           AND (l.event_code IN ('0112', '0114', '0201', '0109', '0302') OR (l.event_code = '0101' AND l.event_message ILIKE '[START]:%') OR l.event_type = 'RUN') 
           THEN 'STALE RUN'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0120') THEN 'BIT BROKEN'
      WHEN (l.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') OR l.event_code LIKE '04%' OR l.event_code LIKE '07%')
           AND l.event_code NOT IN ('0101', '0115') 
           AND l.event_message NOT ILIKE '%Emergency Stop Released%' THEN 'ALARM'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0110', '0214', '0215', '0308', '0310', '0211', '0115', '0119')
           OR l.event_type = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'TOOL_CHANGE'
      WHEN l.event_code = '0108' OR l.event_type = 'STOP' THEN 'STOP'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0112', '0114', '0201', '0109', '0302') 
           OR (l.event_code = '0101' AND l.event_message ILIKE '[START]:%')
           OR l.event_type = 'RUN' THEN 'RUN'
      ELSE 'STANDBY'
    END AS "StateLabel",
    CASE 
      WHEN fr.anchor_time - l.event_time >= INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN 'offline'
      WHEN fr.anchor_time - l.event_time >= INTERVAL '1 hour' 
           AND (l.event_code IN ('0112', '0114', '0201', '0109', '0302') OR (l.event_code = '0101' AND l.event_message ILIKE '[START]:%') OR l.event_type = 'RUN') 
           THEN 'warning'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0120') THEN 'alarm'
      WHEN (l.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') OR l.event_code LIKE '04%' OR l.event_code LIKE '07%')
           AND l.event_code NOT IN ('0101', '0115') 
           AND l.event_message NOT ILIKE '%Emergency Stop Released%' THEN 'alarm'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0110', '0214', '0215', '0308', '0310', '0211', '0115', '0119')
           OR l.event_type = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'warning'
      WHEN l.event_code = '0108' OR l.event_type = 'STOP' THEN 'stop'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0112', '0114', '0201', '0109', '0302') 
           OR (l.event_code = '0101' AND l.event_message ILIKE '[START]:%')
           OR l.event_type = 'RUN' THEN 'run'
      ELSE 'standby'
    END AS "StateClass",
    CASE 
      WHEN fr.anchor_time - l.event_time >= INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN 'OFFLINE'
      WHEN fr.anchor_time - l.event_time >= INTERVAL '1 hour' 
           AND (l.event_code IN ('0112', '0114', '0201', '0109', '0302') OR (l.event_code = '0101' AND l.event_message ILIKE '[START]:%') OR l.event_type = 'RUN') 
           THEN 'STANDBY'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0120') THEN 'ALARM'
      WHEN (l.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E') OR l.event_code LIKE '04%' OR l.event_code LIKE '07%')
           AND l.event_code NOT IN ('0101', '0115') 
           AND l.event_message NOT ILIKE '%Emergency Stop Released%' THEN 'ALARM'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0110', '0214', '0215', '0308', '0310', '0211', '0115', '0119')
           OR l.event_type = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'TOOL_CHANGE'
      WHEN l.event_code = '0108' OR l.event_type = 'STOP' THEN 'STOP'
      WHEN l.event_code IN ('0112', '0114', '0201', '0109', '0302') 
           OR (l.event_code = '0101' AND l.event_message ILIKE '[START]:%')
           OR l.event_type = 'RUN' THEN 'RUN'
      ELSE 'STANDBY'
    END AS "StatusGroup"
  FROM latest_per_eqp l
  CROSS JOIN fleet_ref fr
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.tlp)'))[1] AS prog
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= l.event_time
      AND me.event_time >= l.event_time - INTERVAL '48 hours'
      AND me.event_code IN ('0101', '0103')
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) p ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      ROUND((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)\[Rpm\]:[^>]+->[[:space:]]*([0-9.]+)'))[1]::numeric)::text || 'k' AS rpm,
      ROUND((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)\[Feed\]:[^>]+->[[:space:]]*([0-9.]+)'))[1]::numeric, 1)::text AS feed
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= l.event_time
      AND me.event_time >= l.event_time - INTERVAL '2 hours'
      AND me.event_code = '0109'
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) rf ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      to_char((regexp_match(event_message, '(?i)(?:at hole|Hole:|start:)[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)'))[1]::bigint, 'FM999,999,999') || ' (' ||
      CASE 
        WHEN event_code = '0110' THEN 'Tool Change'
        WHEN event_code = '0108' THEN 'Machine Stop'
        WHEN event_code IN ('0417', '0120') THEN 'Tool is Broken'
        WHEN event_code = '0112' THEN 'Cycle Start'
        ELSE 'Running'
      END || ')' AS holes
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= l.event_time
      AND me.event_time >= l.event_time - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND me.event_code IN ('0110', '0108', '0417', '0120', '0112')
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) h ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      to_char(me.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS sp_report,
      CASE 
        WHEN td_match IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(td_match[1]) != 'OFF' THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN mask_val IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (mask_val & 1) > 0 THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN me.event_message ~ '#1(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-on'
        ELSE 'is-off'
      END AS s1,
      CASE 
        WHEN td_match IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(td_match[2]) != 'OFF' THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN mask_val IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (mask_val & 2) > 0 THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN me.event_message ~ '#2(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-on'
        ELSE 'is-off'
      END AS s2,
      CASE 
        WHEN td_match IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(td_match[3]) != 'OFF' THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN mask_val IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (mask_val & 4) > 0 THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN me.event_message ~ '#3(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-on'
        ELSE 'is-off'
      END AS s3,
      CASE 
        WHEN td_match IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(td_match[4]) != 'OFF' THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN mask_val IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (mask_val & 8) > 0 THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN me.event_message ~ '#4(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-on'
        ELSE 'is-off'
      END AS s4,
      CASE 
        WHEN td_match IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(td_match[5]) != 'OFF' THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN mask_val IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (mask_val & 16) > 0 THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN me.event_message ~ '#5(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-on'
        ELSE 'is-off'
      END AS s5,
      CASE 
        WHEN td_match IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(td_match[6]) != 'OFF' THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN mask_val IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN (mask_val & 32) > 0 THEN 'is-on' ELSE 'is-off' END
        WHEN me.event_message ~ '#6(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-on'
        ELSE 'is-off'
      END AS s6
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        me.event_time,
        me.event_message,
        regexp_match(me.event_message, 'tool diameter:\s*(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)', 'i') AS td_match,
        (regexp_match(me.event_message, 'spindle\s*ON:\s*([0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]::int AS mask_val
      FROM public.machine_event me
      WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
        AND me.event_time <= l.event_time
        AND me.event_time >= l.event_time - INTERVAL '7 days'
        AND me.event_code IN ('0211', '0215')
      ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) me
  ) sp ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
      me.event_message,
      (regexp_match(me.event_message, '(?i)spin[a-z]*[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)'))[1]::int AS alm_mask
    FROM public.machine_event me
    WHERE me.equipment_id = l.equipment_id
      AND me.event_time <= l.event_time
      AND me.event_time >= l.event_time - INTERVAL '1 hour'
      AND (
        me.id = l.id 
        OR me.event_code IN ('0408', '0417', '0404', '0409', '0218', '0425', '0424', '0411', '0421', '0125')
      )
    ORDER BY me.event_time DESC, me.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) sa ON true
),
calculated AS (
  SELECT 
    c.equipment_id AS "Machine",
    COALESCE(c.factory, '?') AS "Factory",
    c."StateLabel",
    c."StateClass",
    c."StatusGroup",
    COALESCE(
      CASE 
        WHEN c.event_code ~ '^[0-9]+' AND (c."StateClass" = 'alarm' OR c.event_type IN ('ALARM', 'E')) THEN 'E-' || c.event_code
        WHEN c.event_code ~ '^[0-9]+' THEN 'M-' || c.event_code
        ELSE c.event_code
      END, 'N/A'
    ) AS "Code",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(regexp_replace(c.event_message, '\s*\(\s*Key\s*''[0-9]''\s*to\s*check\s*\)', '', 'gi')), ''), 'Normal execution') AS "Message",
    CASE
      WHEN c.event_message ~* 'T[0-9]+' AND c.event_message ~* 'C[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ' (' || 
        (regexp_match(c.event_message, 'C([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', 'i'))[1] || 'mm)'
      WHEN c.event_message ~* '->[[:space:]]*T[1-9][0-9]*M[0-9]+' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '->[[:space:]]*(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ' (' || 
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '->[[:space:]]*T[0-9]+(M[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ')'
      WHEN c.event_message ~* 'ATC[[:space:]]*T[1-9][0-9]*M[0-9]+' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, 'ATC[[:space:]]*(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ' (' || 
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, 'ATC[[:space:]]*T[0-9]+(M[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]) || ')'
      WHEN c.event_message ~* '^(T[0-9]+)[[:space:]]+' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '^(T[0-9]+)', 'i'))[1])
      WHEN c.event_message ~* '[[:<:]](T[0-9]{1,4})[[:>:]]' THEN
        UPPER((regexp_match(c.event_message, '[[:<:]](T[0-9]{1,4})[[:>:]]', 'i'))[1])
      ELSE 'N/A'
    END AS "ToolDia",
    COALESCE(c.spindle, 'SPINDLE_MAIN_1') AS "SpindleContext",
    to_char(c.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS "ObservedAt",
    to_char(MAX(c.event_time) OVER () AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS "FleetLatestTime",
    CASE WHEN NOW() - (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM latest_per_eqp) > INTERVAL '24 hours'
       THEN 'REPLAY · no drilling data since ' || to_char((SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM latest_per_eqp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')
            || ' (' || floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM latest_per_eqp)) / 86400)::int || ' d ago) · states and ages below are as of that time'
       ELSE '' END AS "FeedNotice",
    to_char(c.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'HH12:MI:SS AM') AS "LastTime",
    CASE
      WHEN (SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '10 seconds' THEN 'Just now'
      WHEN (SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time)))::TEXT || 's ago'
      WHEN (SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time)) / 60)::TEXT || 'm ago'
      WHEN (SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time)) / 3600)::TEXT || 'h ago'
      ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT anchor_time FROM fleet_ref) - c.event_time)) / 86400)::TEXT || 'd ago'
    END AS "TimeAgo",
    COALESCE(c.holes, 'N/A') AS "Holes",
    CASE WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop', 'offline') THEN 'N/A' ELSE COALESCE(c.prog, 'N/A') END AS "Program",
    CASE WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop', 'offline') THEN 'N/A' ELSE COALESCE(c.rpm, 'N/A') END AS "RPM",
    CASE WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop', 'offline') THEN 'N/A' ELSE COALESCE(c.feed, 'N/A') END AS "FEED",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN (c.alm_mask IS NOT NULL AND (c.alm_mask & 1) > 0) OR c.alm_msg ~* 'spin[^,]*#1(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-alarm'
          ELSE 'is-off'
        END
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop') THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('run', 'warning') THEN COALESCE(c.s1, 'is-off')
      ELSE 'is-off'
    END AS "Spindle1",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN (c.alm_mask IS NOT NULL AND (c.alm_mask & 2) > 0) OR c.alm_msg ~* 'spin[^,]*#2(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-alarm'
          ELSE 'is-off'
        END
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop') THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('run', 'warning') THEN COALESCE(c.s2, 'is-off')
      ELSE 'is-off'
    END AS "Spindle2",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN (c.alm_mask IS NOT NULL AND (c.alm_mask & 4) > 0) OR c.alm_msg ~* 'spin[^,]*#3(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-alarm'
          ELSE 'is-off'
        END
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop') THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('run', 'warning') THEN COALESCE(c.s3, 'is-off')
      ELSE 'is-off'
    END AS "Spindle3",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN (c.alm_mask IS NOT NULL AND (c.alm_mask & 8) > 0) OR c.alm_msg ~* 'spin[^,]*#4(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-alarm'
          ELSE 'is-off'
        END
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop') THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('run', 'warning') THEN COALESCE(c.s4, 'is-off')
      ELSE 'is-off'
    END AS "Spindle4",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN (c.alm_mask IS NOT NULL AND (c.alm_mask & 16) > 0) OR c.alm_msg ~* 'spin[^,]*#5(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-alarm'
          ELSE 'is-off'
        END
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop') THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('run', 'warning') THEN COALESCE(c.s5, 'is-off')
      ELSE 'is-off'
    END AS "Spindle5",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN (c.alm_mask IS NOT NULL AND (c.alm_mask & 32) > 0) OR c.alm_msg ~* 'spin[^,]*#6(?![0-9])' THEN 'is-alarm'
          ELSE 'is-off'
        END
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('standby', 'stop') THEN 'is-off'
      WHEN c."StateClass" IN ('run', 'warning') THEN COALESCE(c.s6, 'is-off')
      ELSE 'is-off'
    END AS "Spindle6",
    CASE 
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 'OFF (No Telemetry)'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'standby' THEN 'OFF (Standby)'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'stop' THEN 'OFF (Stop)'
      WHEN c."StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN 'OFF (Emergency Stop)'
      ELSE COALESCE(c.sp_report, '-')
    END AS "SpindleReport",
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS "TotalCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StatusGroup" = 'RUN') OVER () AS "RunCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StatusGroup" = 'STOP') OVER () AS "StopCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StatusGroup" = 'ALARM') OVER () AS "AlarmCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StatusGroup" = 'TOOL_CHANGE') OVER () AS "ToolChangeCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StatusGroup" = 'STANDBY') OVER () AS "StandbyCount",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."StatusGroup" = 'OFFLINE') OVER () AS "OfflineCount",
    to_char((SELECT tool_event_count FROM window_tool_events), 'FM999,999,999') AS "ToolCount",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAll",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'RUN' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterRun",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'ALARM' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAlarm",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterTool",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'STOP' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterStop",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'STANDBY' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterStandby",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterOffline"
  FROM classified c
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM calculated
  WHERE (${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' 
     OR "StatusGroup" = ${status_filter:sqlstring}
     OR (${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'ALARM' AND "StateClass" = 'alarm')
     OR (${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'OFFLINE' AND "StateClass" = 'offline'))
    AND ('All' IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) OR "Machine" IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
    AND (${program_search:sqlstring} = '' OR "Program" ILIKE '%' || ${program_search:sqlstring} || '%')
),
fallback AS (
  SELECT 
    NULL::text AS "Machine",
    NULL::text AS "Factory",
    NULL::text AS "StateLabel",
    NULL::text AS "StateClass",
    NULL::text AS "StatusGroup",
    NULL::text AS "Code",
    NULL::text AS "Message",
    NULL::text AS "ToolDia",
    NULL::text AS "SpindleContext",
    NULL::text AS "ObservedAt",
    COALESCE((SELECT "FleetLatestTime" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), '-'::text) AS "FleetLatestTime",
    CASE WHEN NOW() - (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM latest_per_eqp) > INTERVAL '24 hours'
       THEN 'REPLAY · no drilling data since ' || to_char((SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM latest_per_eqp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')
            || ' (' || floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM latest_per_eqp)) / 86400)::int || ' d ago) · states and ages below are as of that time'
       ELSE '' END AS "FeedNotice",
    NULL::text AS "LastTime",
    NULL::text AS "TimeAgo",
    NULL::text AS "Holes",
    NULL::text AS "Program",
    NULL::text AS "RPM",
    NULL::text AS "FEED",
    'is-off'::text AS "Spindle1",
    'is-off'::text AS "Spindle2",
    'is-off'::text AS "Spindle3",
    'is-off'::text AS "Spindle4",
    'is-off'::text AS "Spindle5",
    'is-off'::text AS "Spindle6",
    '-'::text AS "SpindleReport",
    COALESCE((SELECT "TotalCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "TotalCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "RunCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "RunCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "StopCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "StopCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "AlarmCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "AlarmCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "ToolChangeCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "ToolChangeCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "StandbyCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "StandbyCount",
    COALESCE((SELECT "OfflineCount" FROM calculated LIMIT 1), 0::bigint) AS "OfflineCount",
    COALESCE(to_char((SELECT tool_event_count FROM window_tool_events), 'FM999,999,999'), '0') AS "ToolCount",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAll",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'RUN' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterRun",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'ALARM' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterAlarm",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'TOOL_CHANGE' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterTool",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'STOP' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterStop",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'STANDBY' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterStandby",
    CASE WHEN ${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'is-active' ELSE '' END AS "ActiveFilterOffline"
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM filtered)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT * FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM fallback
) combined
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN "StateClass" = 'alarm' THEN 1
    WHEN "StateClass" = 'warning' THEN 2
    WHEN "StateClass" = 'run' THEN 3
    WHEN "StateClass" = 'stop' THEN 4
    WHEN "StateClass" = 'standby' THEN 5
    WHEN "StateClass" = 'offline' THEN 6
    ELSE 7
  END ASC,
  "Machine" ASC NULLS LAST;

list.name: machine_id
list.label: Machine
list.query: WITH RECURSIVE t AS ((SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id > t.equipment_id AND equipment_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY equipment_id LIMIT 1) FROM t WHERE t.equipment_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT equipment_id AS __text, equipment_id AS __value FROM t WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL AND ('All' IN (${factory:sqlstring}) OR equipment_id IN (SELECT mm.equipment_id FROM public.machine_master mm WHERE mm.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})));
